marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:

this morning then veering to southeast 20 to 25 near noon. Wind increasing to

evening. Showers and flurries this evening. Flurries Thursday
afternoon. Fog banks dissipating this evening. Fog patches Thursday
afternoon. Temperatures plus 1 falling to minus 2 Thursday
evening. <br/>
